issues.display_title: Issue #408: Refactor Utils Core and Post Functions to GORM Models
issues.main_description_html:
RESULT 28/07/26

✅ Implementation: Refactor Utils Core and Post Functions

Summary

Completed the first utility category from the model-refactor scan.

Changes Applied

  • src/Utils/Functions/Functions.go
    • Added Models import.
    • Replaced CheckEncryptUser direct users table query with Config.DB.Model(&Models.User{}).
    • Replaced SaveLogErr raw INSERT INTO error_log with Config.DB.Create(&Models.ErrorLog{...}).
  • src/Utils/Functions/Registration/RegistrationFunctions.go
    • Replaced CheckUsername direct users table query with Config.DB.Model(&Models.User{}).
  • src/Utils/Functions/PostFunctions/PostsFunctions.go
    • Added Models import.
    • Replaced CheckEmbedPost direct posts table query with Config.DB.Model(&Models.Post{}).
  • src/Utils/Functions/PostFunctions/LocationGrouping.go
    • Added Models import.
    • Replaced db.Table("posts") calls with db.Model(&Models.Post{}) for location-group lookups and updates.

Verification

  • Ran gofmt on modified files.
  • Ran scoped scan:
rg -n "Config\.DB\.(Table|Raw|Exec)|\.Table\(" src\Utils\Functions\Functions.go src\Utils\Functions\Registration\RegistrationFunctions.go src\Utils\Functions\PostFunctions -g "*.go"
  • Result: only a commented-out Config.DB.Exec remains in PostsFunctions.go.

Background

Several utility helpers still query core tables directly with Table or Exec even though matching GORM models already exist. These helpers are shared by multiple API actions, so the refactor must preserve function signatures and return shapes.

Objective

Refactor low-risk utility queries to use existing GORM models without changing caller behavior.

Scope

  • src/Utils/Functions/Functions.go
    • Replace users lookup in CheckEncryptUser with Models.User.
    • Replace error_log insert in SaveLogErr with Models.ErrorLog.
  • src/Utils/Functions/Registration/RegistrationFunctions.go
    • Replace users username lookup with Models.User.
  • src/Utils/Functions/PostFunctions/PostsFunctions.go
    • Replace posts lookup in CheckEmbedPost with Models.Post.
  • src/Utils/Functions/PostFunctions/LocationGrouping.go
    • Replace posts lookup and update queries with Models.Post.

Constraints

  • Do not rename exported functions.
  • Do not change parameters, return types, or response/map keys.
  • Do not refactor commented-out SQL.
  • Keep complex query clauses intact; only replace table targeting with model targeting.

Acceptance Criteria

  • No active Config.DB.Table("users"), Config.DB.Table("posts"), or Config.DB.Exec remains in the scoped utility functions.
  • Code compiles with existing callers.
  • Verification passes with scoped utility tests.

issues.display_title: Issue #409: Refactor Utils Redis Cache Queries to GORM Models
issues.main_description_html:
RESULT 28/07/26

✅ Implementation: Refactor Utils Redis Cache Queries

Summary

Completed the Redis utility model-backed query refactor.

Changes Applied

  • src/Utils/Redis/Redis.go
    • Replaced follower lookup target with Model(&Models.Followers{}).
    • Replaced suggestion query target with Model(&Models.FollowersCountListUser{}).
    • Replaced bookmark list query target with Model(&Models.Bookmark{}).
    • Replaced user detail lookup target with Model(&Models.User{}).
    • Replaced blocked post query target with Model(&Models.BlockedPosts{}).
    • Replaced blocked user query target with Model(&Models.UserBlocks{}).
    • Kept view-backed queries unchanged:
      • views_deactive_users
      • views_list_embed_post

Verification

  • Ran gofmt on src/Utils/Redis/Redis.go.
  • Ran scoped table scan:
rg -n "Config\.DB\.Table\(|\.Table\(" src\Utils\Redis\Redis.go
  • Result: only views_* projection queries remain.
  • Ran:
go test ./src/Utils/Redis
  • Result: passed, no test files.

Background

Redis cache builders still target core tables with raw Table(...) strings even though GORM models exist. These helpers hydrate Redis keys used by user suggestions, bookmarks, user details, blocked posts, and blocked users.

Objective

Refactor low-risk Redis utility queries to use existing GORM models while preserving Redis keys, encoded payloads, query semantics, and return values.

Scope

  • src/Utils/Redis/Redis.go
    • Replace followers AS f query target with Models.Followers.
    • Replace followers_counts fc query target with Models.FollowersCountListUser.
    • Replace bookmark b query target with Models.Bookmark.
    • Replace users u query target with Models.User.
    • Replace blocked_posts query target with Models.BlockedPosts.
    • Replace user_blocks ub query target with Models.UserBlocks.

Constraints

  • Do not change Redis key names, TTLs, base64 encoding, or JSON payload shape.
  • Do not refactor views_* queries in this batch.
  • Keep join SQL and filters semantically equivalent.
  • Do not change exported function signatures.

Acceptance Criteria

  • No active Config.DB.Table(...) remains for model-backed tables in the scoped file.
  • views_* table queries may remain as projection/view queries.
  • go test ./src/Utils/Redis is attempted.
